articles.title: Why The Narrative Around Delta Air Lines DAL Is Shifting After New Analyst Updates
articles.mainIdea: Why The Narrative Around Delta Air Lines DAL Is Shifting After New Analyst Updates
articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: Why The Narrative Around Delta Air Lines DAL Is Shifting After New Analyst Updates. Delta Air Lines has seen its fair value estimate nudged from US$81.89 to US$81.29, a small move that still reflects active debate among analysts over how demand trends and industry capacity could shape the story into 2026. At the same time, the discount rate has been trimmed from 9.03% to 8.85%, while long term revenue growth assumptions are held at 4.75%. articles.title: TTTECH North America wins contract to upgrade U.S. Army’s HADES ISR digital backbone
articles.mainIdea: TTTECH North America wins contract to upgrade U.S. Army’s HADES ISR digital backbone
articles.summary: GlobeNewswire: TTTECH North America wins contract to upgrade U.S. Army’s HADES ISR digital backbone. Andover, MA, Feb. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- TTTECH North America is proud to announce its selection to deliver advanced Time-Sensitive Networking (TSN) solutions to the U.S. Army’s High Accuracy Detection and Exploitation System (HADES) aerial intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) program. This milestone highlights TTTECH’s continued competence in providing cutting-edge, MOSA-compliant, data networking solutions for mission systems as well as integrated, modular avionics (IMA) Related tickers mentioned: BDRAF.
